claims.basis: The exact AC vehicle listing and contemporary 1966 road-test material identify the GT40 family and five-speed ZF arrangement; the local package id distinguishes it from the existing 1965 WSC60 content.

Both period-specification sources describe a five-speed ZF arrangement. The period source describes a solid gear lever operating the manual gearbox; no sequential or paddle control is documented. The manual H-pattern arrangement requires a clutch to pull away from rest under the project's derivation rules. Manual blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Automatic blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Throttle lift is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. Automatic cut is modeled only for upshifts in this schema.
